Both are National Capital Area campaign memoranda with the same addressee, appointment of a Government Unit chairman, request for fullest support, an almost verbatim list of expected cooperation measures, description of the federated Community Chests and Red Feather services, inclusion of the United Defense Fund and its component programs, and a closing appeal for generous fair-share contributions supporting services for a full year. C21 and C06 share some campaign machinery and subject matter, but neither matches the child's language and full sequence as closely as C09.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I ask that you give to Mr. Mansure your fullest measure of support and assistance. ... Such cooperation should logically include the assumption of equitable unit goals, the effective solicitation of all employees, and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.","parent_excerpt":"I ask that you give him your fullest measure of support and assistance. ... Such cooperation would logically include the assumption of equitable unit goals, the effective solicitation of all employees, and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.","explanation":"Nearly verbatim operative language, with only the chairman's name and minor modal wording changed."},{"child_excerpt":"The Community Chest Federation responsible for this annual appeal unites 6 Community Chests and more than 100 Red Feather services in one federated campaign to provide local health, welfare and recreational programs","parent_excerpt":"In the National Capital Area the Community Chest Federation unites six Community Chests and more than one hundred Red Feather Agencies in one federated campaign to provide local health, welfare and recreational programs","explanation":"The same distinctive institutional description appears in the same position in the memorandum."},{"child_excerpt":"the appeal will again include the United Defense Fund which is responsible for the programs of the USO, USO Camp Shows, and United Community Defense Services. These programs continue to be essential to the morale and happiness of our men and women of the Armed Forces both at home and overseas.","parent_excerpt":"Included in the Red Feather Campaign this year will be the appeal of the United Defense Fund which includes, among others, the USO-USO Camp Shows and United Community Defense Services. These programs are essential to the morale and happiness of our men and women of the Armed Forces both at home and overseas.","explanation":"Substantially identical program enumeration and justification, adapted to the following year's campaign."},{"child_excerpt":"It is my hope that all officials and employees will be given the opportunity to contribute and that each will want to do so generously. Each individual's giving should reflect a fair share towards the support of these worthwhile services in effective operation throughout the full year ahead.","parent_excerpt":"It is my hope that all officials and employees will be given the opportunity to contribute and that they will do so generously ... When you give--give your fair share to support these worthwhile services for a full year.","explanation":"The closing appeal preserves the same sequence and distinctive concepts of opportunity, generosity, fair-share giving, and full-year support."}]}
